clue.text: Something left round bar by an anti-monarchist

indicators.note: round says the leftover thing is wrapped about the bar

parts.note: a relic is something left behind from the past
a pub is a bar
taken as written

explanation.surface: A leftover object sits by a bar beside someone who wants rid of the monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: A republican wants a state headed by an elected president rather than a monarch.

clue.text: Rewritten part in "Spellbound"

indicators.note: something rewritten has had its letters set down again in a new order

explanation.surface: A role has been rewritten in a production called Spellbound.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapt and spellbound are synonyms: both describe someone wholly absorbed.

clue.text: Try to sell flipping hot drink

indicators.note: flipping turns the following pieces over so they read backwards

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to flog a blasted cup of hot drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild British oath, but it turns HSUP round.
explanation.definitionFit: To push goods is to promote them hard, trying to sell them.

clue.text: Urgent problem posed by children guilty of 17?

explanation.surface: A pressing problem is raised by youngsters who have committed a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 17 is ARSON, so children guilty of it are an issue (offspring) that is burning things.
explanation.definitionFit: A burning issue is an idiom for a pressing, hotly debated question; issue also means offspring, here setting fires.

clue.text: Record company that is backing popular band at last

indicators.note: backing means the abbreviation for that is comes behind the other pieces

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of the word band

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for that is (id est)

explanation.surface: A record label supports a popular group at long last.
explanation.definitionFit: An indie is an independent record label, not one of the big companies.

clue.text: Current ambition, to pen translation of Sartre

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so one piece holds the other inside

parts.note: aim means ambition, a goal

indicators.note: a translation puts the French writer's name into a different form, here its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: The goal is to write a translation of the French philosopher Sartre's work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' is the noun, a flow, not 'present'; 'to pen' means to enclose, and 'translation of' scrambles the French philosopher's name.
explanation.definitionFit: An airstream is a current of air, so current here is the noun for a flow.

clue.text: Hobble one mile between lake and car park sign

indicators.note: between puts the first pair of pieces inside the outer two

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for lake on maps
a car park is signed with a P
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone hobbles a mile between a lake and the car park.
explanation.definitionFit: To limp is to hobble, walking unevenly because of an injury.

clue.text: Asian is honest at heart and outwardly brave

indicators.note: outwardly says one piece forms the outside of the other

parts.note: a brave is a Native American warrior, an Indian in the old sense

indicators.note: at heart takes the inner letters of the word honest

explanation.surface: An Asian person is honest deep down and brave on the outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brave' looks like an adjective but is the noun for a Native American warrior; 'is' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An Indonesian comes from Indonesia, a nation of South-East Asia.

clue.text: One who'll advocate supporting striker

parts.note: pro means in favour of, supporting
a pounder is one who strikes or hammers

explanation.surface: A football supporter speaks up for the team's centre forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To propound is to put forward an idea, so a propounder advocates it.

clue.text: Job conditions for deliverymen

parts.note: a post is a job
riders are conditions added to an agreement

explanation.surface: Terms of employment are set out for delivery staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Post riders were mounted couriers who carried the mail on horseback.

clue.text: Edible plant being cooked does shrink quite a lot

indicators.note: the two words shrink a great deal, leaving only a short run from their middle

explanation.surface: A vegetable shrinks considerably when it is cooked.
explanation.walkthrough: The plant is inside cookED DOes; 'being' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The eddo is the taro, a tropical plant grown for its edible root.

clue.text: Gather together a set of garments for clothing British diplomat

indicators.note: clothing means wrapping around, so one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: to amass is to gather together
taken as written
dress means clothing collectively

explanation.surface: Someone collects a wardrobe of outfits to dress a British envoy.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassadress is a female ambassador, a diplomat of the highest rank.

clue.text: Birds love to entertain chaps playfully it's noted

parts.note: a diver is a water bird

indicators.note: to entertain is to host, so the others hold the chaps inside

parts.note: a tit is a small bird
men means chaps
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Birds are fond of amusing men with their playful song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Birds' supplies two different birds side by side, and 'to entertain' puts the chaps inside them after love is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A divertimento is a light, playful piece of music, so a jaunty thing written in notes.

clue.text: Creature once again dives on to stream, landing upside down

indicators.note: in a down entry, upside down means the letters run from bottom to top

parts.note: redips means dips once again
flow means stream

explanation.surface: An animal plunges again into the water and ends up the wrong way up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on to' places REDIPS above FLOW in the down entry, and the whole is then read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A wolf spider is a hunting spider, a creature that chases its prey.

clue.text: Thought judge had suppressed start of ballot

parts.note: ref, a referee, is a judge in sport

indicators.note: suppressed start of means the opening letter of the word for the vote is dropped

parts.note: an election is a ballot

explanation.surface: A judge thought he had stifled the beginning of the vote.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflection is a thought, a considered idea after careful thinking.

clue.text: Chef has a hand in this novel veg concoction served with duck

definitions.text: Chef has a hand in this

parts.note: a duck is a score of nought in cricket, the letter O

indicators.note: a concoction mixes things together, so these letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: A cook takes part in making a new vegetable dish served with duck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has a hand in' looks like taking part; literally the chef's hand goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A chef's hand goes inside an oven glove to handle hot dishes.

clue.text: Savvy players sometimes sign name here

explanation.surface: Clever footballers sometimes give autographs.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alert and quick-witted is the idiom; literally, players autograph a match ball.

clue.text: Start off campaigns against crime

indicators.note: start off means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: wars are military campaigns
on can mean against, as in leaning on a wall

explanation.surface: Begin campaigns to fight crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start off' reads as begin; it drops W from WARS.
explanation.definitionFit: Arson, deliberately setting fire to property, is a crime.

clue.text: Incomplete document with handwritten text and pictures

indicators.note: incomplete means the word for the document loses its last letter

parts.note: a file is a document
MS is the abbreviation for manuscript

explanation.surface: An unfinished document has handwritten notes and illustrations.
explanation.definitionFit: Pictures is an informal word for films, as in going to the pictures.

clue.text: Paper chase to obtain holiday property

parts.note: The Times is a newspaper
to hare is to run fast, as if chasing

explanation.surface: A newspaper's pursuit to acquire a holiday home.
explanation.definitionFit: A timeshare is a holiday property owned jointly, each owner using it for set weeks.

clue.text: Scotsman accompanies crusader that's tortured knaves?

parts.note: a Pict was an ancient inhabitant of Scotland

indicators.note: tortured means twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scotsman goes along with a crusader who has tortured villains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knaves' looks like rogues; the question mark points to the card, jack.
explanation.definitionFit: Knaves are jacks, which with kings and queens are the picture cards in a pack.

clue.text: Items regularly removed from baggage room, creating trouble

indicators.note: every other letter is removed from the two words, leaving the rest

explanation.surface: Things are taken from the luggage room at intervals, causing a row.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggro is British slang for aggressive trouble or hassle.

clue.text: Character in Purcell opera was inactive

explanation.surface: A role in a Purcell opera was never active.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'was inactive' as did nothing: DID plus O for zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Dido is the Queen of Carthage in Purcell's opera Dido and Aeneas; literally did nought.

clue.text: Attend club

explanation.surface: Go to the nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as BE AT, to attend; as one word, to club is to beat.
explanation.definitionFit: Be at means attend, and to club someone is to beat them.

clue.text: Parliament's not wanting Liberal to make a stand

indicators.note: not wanting means the piece is left out

parts.note: the Dail is the Irish parliament; with the possessive it gives the S

explanation.surface: Parliament, without the Liberals, makes a stand.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dáil is the lower house of Ireland's parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: A dais is a raised platform, a stand for a speaker.

clue.text: Flower, one in row planted by small child

indicators.note: planted by means put inside by another piece

parts.note: a mite is a small child
an arguer is one taking part in a row, a quarrel

explanation.surface: A small child plants one flower in a row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' looks like a line of plants; it is a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: The marguerite is a daisy-like flower, the ox-eye daisy.

clue.text: Band producing resonant sound

explanation.surface: A group making a resounding noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring is a circular band; it is also the clear sound of a bell.

clue.text: In the chase, dashing young men will get left behind

indicators.note: behind says the word for left comes after the other piece

parts.note: bloods are dashing young men of fashion
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: On the hunt, smart young men will be left behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunting, the chase, is a blood sport, killing animals for sport.
